card.name: Inside drug names and section headings
card.fires_on: Word starts or joints inside drug-label terms, such as the break in angiotensin-converting, CYP3A, cytochrome P450, or the first piece of a repeated heading word. It also fires on punctuation in section numbers.

modes.label: Inside enzyme and drug terms
modes.description: A split point within a multi-part drug or enzyme name.

modes.label: Repeated heading word
modes.description: The first piece of a drug or condition name that restates the section heading just before it.
modes.example: 5.3 Angioedema<< Ang>>ioedema of the face, lips

modes.label: Section number and sentence punctuation
modes.description: A period or comma in a section number or list, or a sentence start after a heading.
modes.example: Risk of Driving and Operating Machinery D

card.plain: It fires partway through drug and enzyme names and just after section headings in drug labels.
